SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at <= NOW() THEN d.actual_value END), 0) AS won_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.created_at <= NOW() THEN d.value END), 0) AS new_pipeline, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.created_at <= NOW() THEN 1 END) AS new_pipeline_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at <= NOW() THEN 1 END) AS won_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.won = FALSE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at <= NOW() THEN 1 END) AS lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = FALSE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at <= NOW() THEN d.value END), 0) AS lost_value, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at <= NOW() AND d.closed_at >= d.created_at THEN DATEDIFF(d.closed_at, d.created_at) END), 0) AS avg_cycle_days FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
AND d.currency = #{currency}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.closed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN d.actual_value END), 0) AS won_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN d.value END), 0) AS new_pipeline, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN 1 END) AS new_pipeline_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.closed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN 1 END) AS won_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.won = FALSE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.closed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN 1 END) AS lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = FALSE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.closed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN d.value END), 0) AS lost_value, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE AND d.closed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{previousDays} DAY) AND d.closed_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND d.closed_at >= d.created_at THEN DATEDIFF(d.closed_at, d.created_at) END), 0) AS avg_cycle_days FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
